Architecture insight documented: slot comparison belongs in memory write path (not intent path). Cascade/BDG should measure incoming contradictions against full dependency graph. Multi-valued slot schema proposed (current/concurrent/deprecated with temporal weighting).
Write-path contradiction fix deployed: ledger entries now created inside store_memory() slot exclusivity loop, fires regardless of intent routing. Dedup guard prevents double entries.

Contradiction Pipeline Lab v1 run: 7/10 (should-fire 2/5, should-NOT-fire 5/5). Zero false positives. Age (T3) passed full chain (metadata + ledger + demotion). Location (T2) passed via trust demotion in long-form text. Name (T1), employer (T4), favorite_color (T5) failed — root cause: extract_fact_slots (regex) cannot parse indirect phrasing, buried context, or contextual declarations.

Lab v2 run in progress: enabled TwoTierFactSystem with local LLM extraction (llama3.2 via Ollama) to test whether local models improve slot extraction from natural language. Establishes escalation baseline before cloud extraction.
Lab v2 (local LLM): untestable — llama3.2 added 30-250s per write, caused 300s timeouts. Reverted to regex-only.
Lab v3 (cloud, shared DB): aborted — cloud slot classification triggered 81-memory cascade demotion through shared production DB. Memories restored. Routing reverted to local_only.
DB isolation added to lab harness: starts own backend on port 8099 with CRT_SHARED_MEMORY=false. Each lab thread gets isolated DB. Added --skip-seed, --start-from flags for resumability.

Two write-path guards added: (1) same-value substring skip prevents reinforcements from creating false contradictions, (2) third-person filter skips slot extraction when text is about someone else. Fixes T8 and T9 false positives.

Lab v4 final results: 8/9 (T1 reclassified as identity-level, not belief). Should-fire 3/4, should-NOT-fire 5/5. Zero false positives. One remaining gap: T5 contextual color declaration (extraction limitation). T4 employer-in-paragraph now passes with isolated DB.

Standalone Lab v5: 10/10. No pipeline, no Ollama, no backend. Regex + cloud (gpt-4o-mini) + slot comparison. All probes pass. T5 closed. Third-person filter catches 'my friend Sarah works at Google'. ~17 seconds total.

v3 cloud reclassification pass on GPT corpus: 45 pairs upgraded to genuine_contradiction (47→92, 10.4%→20.3%).
